description: Public turn-26 gathering/checkpoint regression. No accounts, credentials, private GM notes or prompts.

location.name: The Sunward Steps of Aztlan
location.atmosphere: A broad ceremonial terrace of polished black stone and gold, crowded with vendors, petitioners, porters, and the constant hum of Soul Core machinery.
location.hazard: The terrace is orderly but not gentle: a raised blood-channel borders the avenue, and the imperial guards enforce public law with practiced speed.

location.name: The Temple Ward
location.atmosphere: An active precinct of stepped sanctuaries, painted workshops, incense braziers, and ritual courtyards, where priests and artisans move beneath vivid banners.
location.hazard: Ritual channels and restricted shrine thresholds require care; attendants and guards watch the crowds, but no immediate threat is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: The ward is occupied and orderly, with visible attendants and no immediate violence or active hazard threatening visitors.

location.name: The Inner Sanctuary Walk
location.atmosphere: An active, ancient processional way of worn stone reliefs and high banners, leading between the Temple Ward and deeper sanctuaries.
location.hazard: Ritual channels score the paving near the shrine thresholds; attendants watch the approach, and visitors are expected to keep to the processional path.

97b57c8b-0736-446e-8c8e-bfbe9a178471:pub.information: The Inner Sanctuary Walk is a public processional route; attendants keep visitors to the path, and no active blood ritual is visible here.

encounterRisk.reason: The walk is occupied by attendants and pilgrims, with no immediate violence or active hazard threatening visitors.

location.name: The Copperwater Market
location.atmosphere: A busy canal-side market of covered stalls, copperwork, ritual pigments, and spice counters, with barges unloading beneath carved stone bridges.
location.hazard: The quay edges are slick with canal spray, and porters shoulder heavy cargo through the crowd; no immediate threat is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: The market is crowded and active, but no immediate violence or hazard threatens visitors.

location.name: The Inner Sanctuary
location.atmosphere: A living sanctuary of stepped stone, gold-inlaid doorways, incense braziers, and solemn processions beneath painted ceilings.
location.hazard: Ritual channels cross the paving near restricted thresholds, where attendants and guards watch visitors closely.

e2e0fc84-96cf-4198-b32f-913881db9e58:pub.information: No blood-priest gathering is visible in the public Inner Sanctuary; a discreet consultation notice points toward the screened eastern ritual court.

encounterRisk.reason: The sanctuary is occupied and orderly; no immediate violence or active hazard threatens visitors.

location.name: The Veiled Court
location.atmosphere: A screened ritual court of red-painted pillars, incense braziers, and curtained alcoves where physicians and ritual attendants receive private consultations.
location.hazard: The inner rooms are restricted, and attendants closely monitor the treatment spaces; no immediate threat is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: The court is staffed and orderly, with no immediate violence or active hazard threatening visitors.

location.name: The Processional Avenue
location.atmosphere: A broad, active thoroughfare of gold-faced façades and carved lintels, where porters, carts, petitioners, and imperial patrols thread through the capital’s steady traffic.
location.hazard: Wagon congestion and dense foot traffic demand care, but no immediate violence or active hazard threatens visitors.

encounterRisk.reason: The avenue is crowded and guarded, but orderly, with no immediate violence or active hazard threatening travelers.

location.name: North Causeway
location.atmosphere: A raised stone road follows the canal works beyond the ceremonial avenues. Sluice towers and busy loading yards stand between the road and the distant roofs of the capital.
location.hazard: The causeway narrows beside deep water, and heavy carts share the road with workers carrying cargo. No immediate violence or active threat is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: Busy canal and cargo traffic surrounds the route, but no immediate violence or active hazard threatens travelers.

location.name: North Road
location.atmosphere: A busy stone road extends beyond the capital’s canal works, passing cargo yards, irrigated fields, and watchful waystations beneath the distant city walls.
location.hazard: Wagon traffic and uneven paving demand attention; no immediate violence or active hazard is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: The road carries ordinary commercial traffic, with no immediate threat apparent.

location.name: Outer North Road
location.atmosphere: A busy stone road extends beyond the capital’s cargo yards, passing irrigated fields and watchful waystations beneath distant walls.
location.hazard: Wagon traffic and uneven paving demand attention; no immediate violence or active hazard is evident.

encounterRisk.reason: Ordinary commercial traffic and uneven paving are present, but no immediate threat is apparent.

location.name: Canal Loading Yard
location.atmosphere: Busy stone loading platforms beside powerful sluice gates, with barges, cargo crews, and Soul Core-powered lifting machinery in constant motion.
location.hazard: Deep, fast water borders the quay; heavy cargo and moving machinery make the work area hazardous, though no immediate violence is evident.

enemies.tactic: Presses forward with a hooking thrust, trying to drive its target away from the quay edge.

location.name: Northern Waystation
location.atmosphere: A busy roadside station of shaded stone galleries, water jars, tethering posts, and a watch platform above the irrigated fields. Travelers and cargo crews pass through under the attention of stationed officials.
location.hazard: Wagon traffic and livestock crowd the yard; the raised watch platform and open fields are visible, but no immediate threat is apparent.

encounterRisk.reason: The waystation is active and watched, with ordinary travel congestion but no sign of immediate violence.

location.name: North Road Beyond the Waystation
location.atmosphere: A paved imperial road runs between irrigated fields and low stone markers, with the Northern Waystation behind and open country ahead. A few distant travelers move along the route.
location.hazard: Wagons share the uneven road with field traffic; no immediate threat is apparent.

encounterRisk.reason: Ordinary road traffic and uneven paving are present, but no immediate violence or active hazard is evident.

location.name: Far North Road
location.atmosphere: An imperial road crosses open irrigated country beyond the Northern Waystation, bordered by field channels and low stone markers. The capital’s walls sit distant behind the fields.
location.hazard: Uneven paving and roadside irrigation channels require care; no immediate threat is apparent.

loot.name: Roadside Vaal Shortsword
loot.description: A plain, serviceable bronze shortsword, wrapped in worn leather and left beside a field marker.

encounterRisk.reason: The road carries ordinary travelers and field traffic, with no visible immediate threat.

sivet.name: Sivet
sivet.fact: Gemling legionaire tells Sivet he is a mercenary available for hire and asks whether he has an escort contract. Sivet says no escort job is ready at the spice stalls, but offers to pass the offer to a licensed broker whose caravan is being rerouted around a flooded canal. He warns that the broker will expect a clear price and proof of competence.

maeva.name: Maeva
maeva.fact: Xulath shouts at Maeva, “TEST ME OR I WILL SPILL YOUR BLOOD INSTEAD.” Maeva does not agree to test him. She steps behind the consultation screen as two attendants move between them, and tells him, “Threats are not a proposal. Leave the court, or speak plainly without threatening my staff.” No one draws a weapon, and no violence occurs.

oren-vask.name: Oren Vask
oren-vask.fact: Gemling legionaire asks Oren Vask when the caravan cargo will be ready. Oren says the last copper fittings are being secured and the manifest checked; he expects the caravan to depart shortly, but it has not yet been loaded for departure. Gemling legionaire searches the nearby market while they talk, finding no particular object or lead.

tovek.name: Tovek
tovek.fact: Tovek is a hired porter driving a cart along the Processional Avenue. Gemling legionaire asks him about the Unbound Ledger; Tovek has heard rumors of forged labor papers but knows no reliable names or contacts.
